name: Spinola Bay House with Terrace and Fire Pit
intro: A renovated three-bedroom Maltese house a short walk from Spinola Bay. Traditional stone details, an open-plan living and kitchen area, a cosy indoor fireplace and a private terrace with BBQ. You enter straight from the street, with no shared corridors or lifts.
highlights: Private terrace with BBQ and outdoor seating
2.5 bathrooms, one with a full bathtub
Work desk in the master bedroom
sleeps: Master bedroom with a large bed, a twin room with two singles and a third room with a king bed. Sleeps six comfortably.
nearby: Spinola Bay and its waterfront restaurants are a few minutes on foot. Balluta Bay, Paceville and the St Julian's bus routes are all within walking distance.

name: Spacious Spinola Bay Apartment
intro: A calm three-bedroom apartment in a residential block a few steps from Spinola Bay. Partially renovated in 2024, with fast WiFi, TVs in the living room and two bedrooms, a desk for working and an indoor electric fire pit in the lounge.
highlights: TVs in the living room and two bedrooms
sleeps: Master bedroom with ensuite, a second double bedroom and a third room with two single beds. Sleeps six.
nearby: Spinola Bay restaurants, the St Julian's promenade, Balluta Bay and Paceville are all walkable. Buses to Valletta and Sliema stop nearby.

name: Pietà Maisonette with Large Backyard
intro: A modern ground-floor maisonette with direct street access and a very spacious private backyard with outdoor furniture and a BBQ. Ten minutes from Valletta, with air conditioning and smart TVs in every room and a spa shower in the ensuite.
highlights: AC and TV in every room
Main bathroom with bathtub, ensuite with spa shower
Sofa bed for one adult or two children
sleeps: One bedroom with a king-size bed and ensuite, a second with two single beds, plus a sofa bed in the living room. Sleeps up to five.
nearby: Valletta is ten minutes away by bus or car. Msida marina, the University of Malta and Mater Dei Hospital are all close.

name: Skyview Penthouse in Ta' Xbiex
intro: A bright penthouse in a quiet residential street of Ta' Xbiex, with a long open-plan living space and a huge private terrace with lounge seating, a dining table for four and a gas BBQ. Lift in the building and self check-in.
highlights: Huge private terrace with gas BBQ
Two king-size bedrooms, one with ensuite
Walk-in glass showers in both bathrooms
sleeps: Two bedrooms, both with king-size beds. Sleeps four.
nearby: Ta' Xbiex marina and the yacht clubs are a short walk. Msida, Gzira and Sliema are minutes away and Valletta is a short bus ride.

name: Chic Two-Bedroom Flat in Central Valletta
intro: A spacious, tastefully decorated two-bedroom apartment in the heart of the capital. Modern comfort inside a traditional Valletta building, with the city's cafés, museums and harbour views a few steps from the door.
highlights: Right in the centre of Valletta
Two bedrooms, sleeps up to five
Ferries to Sliema and the Three Cities nearby
sleeps: Two bedrooms plus extra sleeping space in the living room. Sleeps up to five.
nearby: St John's Co-Cathedral, the Upper Barrakka Gardens, Republic Street and the Valletta waterfront are all on foot. The Sliema and Three Cities ferries leave from the city.

name: Traditional Valletta Home with Courtyard
intro: A one-of-a-kind traditional home in the very heart of Valletta, laid out over a ground floor and a lower level like many original Valletta houses. A glass floor in the bedroom lets daylight into the kitchen below, and a quiet internal courtyard opens straight into the bedroom.
sleeps: One bedroom on the ground floor. Sleeps two.
nearby: Everything in Valletta is on foot: the Grand Harbour, the main shopping street, restaurants and the ferries.
note: The home has a more enclosed, atmospheric feel than a modern flat and natural light is softer. Access to the kitchen involves a short flight of stairs.

name: Private Room in a Sliema Townhouse (Room 1)
intro: A spacious private room on the ground floor of a unique Sliema townhouse that mixes modern and traditional. Large bed, AC and a workspace, with a shared brand-new kitchen, a backyard with BBQ and a rooftop terrace with gym equipment.
highlights: Shared kitchen with washing machine and dryer
Five minutes on foot to Exiles beach
sleeps: One private bedroom. Sleeps two.
nearby: Four grocery shops within walking distance, Lidl five minutes away, bus stops 30 seconds from the door and Exiles beach five minutes on foot.

name: Private Room with Maltese Balcony in Sliema (Room 2)
intro: A big, bright private room with a traditional Maltese balcony, an L-shaped sofa, smart TV and AC, in the same quiet Sliema townhouse. Shared new kitchen, backyard BBQ and a rooftop chill-out area.
highlights: L-shaped sofa and smart TV in the room
Shared kitchen with washing machine and dryer
sleeps: One private bedroom. Sleeps two.
nearby: Central Sliema: shops, the seafront promenade and Exiles beach all within a few minutes' walk.

name: Design Townhouse with Splash Pool in Sliema
intro: A quirky, magazine-featured townhouse over four floors in the heart of Sliema. A splash pool and BBQ in the yard, a master bathroom with a standing bathtub, a solarium terrace with sun loungers and a rooftop for dinners with a view.
highlights: Private splash pool in the yard
Standing bathtub in the master bathroom
Two washing machines and a dryer
sleeps: Master bedroom on the first floor and a king-size guest bedroom on the second. Sleeps four.
nearby: Sliema's seafront, the ferry to Valletta, the Tigné shopping area and the Balluta and St Julian's bays are all walkable.

name: Ensuite with Maltese Balcony, Three Cities Guest House (Room 5)
intro: A spacious, modern ensuite room with a traditional Maltese balcony in a family-run guest house in Cospicua, one of the Three Cities. Next to the Valletta ferry and the American University, with a shared rooftop overlooking the harbour.
sleeps: One private ensuite room. Sleeps two.
nearby: The Cospicua ferry to Valletta, the Dock 1 waterfront, Birgu and Senglea are all a short walk.

name: Cosy Modern Ensuite, Three Cities Guest House (Room 1)
intro: A cosy, modern ensuite room in the same family guest house in Cospicua. Right next to the Valletta ferry and the American University, with the sea, bus stops, restaurants and supermarkets all within walking distance.
sleeps: One private ensuite room. Sleeps two.
nearby: Ferry to Valletta in minutes, Dock 1 waterfront, Birgu and Senglea on foot.

name: Bright Ensuite, Three Cities Guest House (Room 2)
intro: A bright, cosy ensuite room in the Cospicua guest house. Modern finish, private bathroom and access to the shared kitchen and the rooftop terrace with views over the Grand Harbour.
sleeps: One private ensuite room. Sleeps two.
nearby: Ferry to Valletta, Dock 1 waterfront, Birgu and Senglea on foot.

name: Modern Ensuite next to the Valletta Ferry (Room 3)
intro: A modern ensuite room in the family guest house in Cospicua, right next to the ferry that takes you to Valletta in a few minutes. Shared kitchen and a rooftop terrace with views of the harbour.
sleeps: One private ensuite room. Sleeps two.
nearby: Ferry to Valletta, Dock 1 waterfront, Birgu and Senglea on foot.

name: Ensuite with Balcony, Three Cities Guest House (Room 4)
intro: A bright room with a super king bed, private bathroom, desk, wardrobe and its own balcony, in the Cospicua guest house next to the Valletta ferry. Shared kitchen and rooftop terrace with harbour views.
sleeps: One private ensuite room with a super king bed. Sleeps two.
nearby: Ferry to Valletta, Dock 1 waterfront, Birgu and Senglea on foot.

name: Elegant Ensuite at Jungle Palazzo, Senglea (Monkey Room)
intro: An elegant, spacious ensuite in Jungle Palazzo, an old palazzo in the heart of Senglea renovated into a stylish five-room guest house. High ceilings, a private bathroom, AC and heating, and a shared kitchen on the ground floor.
highlights: Shared kitchen, washing machine and dryer
Bus or ferry to Valletta in 10 minutes
sleeps: One private ensuite room. Sleeps two.
nearby: The Senglea waterfront, the Gardjola Gardens viewpoint, Birgu and the Valletta ferry are all a few minutes on foot.

name: Parrot Suite at Jungle Palazzo, Senglea
intro: A cosy private suite with an elegant touch and an open-style bathroom, inside Jungle Palazzo in Senglea. Stylish shared lounge, high ceilings and the historic charm of one of the Three Cities right outside.
highlights: Shared kitchen, washing machine and dryer
sleeps: One private suite. Sleeps two.
nearby: Senglea waterfront, Gardjola Gardens, Birgu and the Valletta ferry within a short walk.

name: Leopard Room at Jungle Palazzo, Senglea
intro: A bright, cosy ensuite room with a balcony at Jungle Palazzo in Senglea. Private bathroom, AC and heating, views over a local Senglea street and a shared kitchen on the ground floor.
highlights: Shared kitchen, washing machine and dryer
Bus or ferry to Valletta in 10 minutes
sleeps: One private ensuite room. Sleeps two.
nearby: Senglea waterfront, Gardjola Gardens, Birgu and the Valletta ferry within a short walk.

name: Tiger Room at Jungle Palazzo, Senglea
intro: A cosy, stylish ensuite on the first floor of Jungle Palazzo in Senglea. Private bathroom, AC and heating, high ceilings and a shared kitchen downstairs. Valletta is ten minutes away by bus or ferry.
highlights: First-floor room in a historic palazzo
Shared kitchen, washing machine and dryer
sleeps: One private ensuite room. Sleeps two.
nearby: Senglea waterfront, Gardjola Gardens, Birgu and the Valletta ferry within a short walk.

name: Snake Suite at Jungle Palazzo, Senglea
intro: A chic ensuite suite on the second floor of Jungle Palazzo in Senglea. Private bathroom, AC and heating, high ceilings and a shared kitchen on the ground floor, in one of the most authentic corners of Malta.
highlights: Second-floor suite in a historic palazzo
Shared kitchen, washing machine and dryer
sleeps: One private ensuite suite. Sleeps two.
nearby: Senglea waterfront, Gardjola Gardens, Birgu and the Valletta ferry within a short walk.

name: Modern Two-Bedroom Apartment near the Sea in Marsaskala
intro: A brand-new two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment in the seaside town of Marsaskala, with a large front terrace and dining table, two king-size beds, AC and heating in every room and a sofa bed for a fifth guest. First floor with a lift.
highlights: Large front terrace with dining table
AC and heating in every room
Baby cot and high chair on request
sleeps: Master bedroom with king-size bed and private bathroom, second bedroom with a king-size bed, plus a sofa bed. Sleeps up to five.
nearby: St Thomas Bay, the Marsaskala promenade, cafés, supermarkets and the bus stop are all within walking distance.

name: Designer One-Bedroom Flat with Two Balconies in San Gwann
intro: A bright, design-forward one-bedroom apartment in a quiet central street between San Gwann and St Julian's. Modern kitchen with breakfast bar, a walk-in rain shower, AC in every room and two private balconies, one with sunset city views.
sleeps: One bedroom opening onto its own balcony. Sleeps two.
nearby: A short walk to Balluta Bay and the seaside promenade, with restaurants, shops and bus stops close by.

name: Townhouse with Rooftop Pool near Mdina
intro: A brand-new townhouse in the heart of Rabat, steps from the silent city of Mdina, with a private rooftop pool and chill-out area overlooking the skyline. Two ensuite bedrooms, a skylit living room and an electric fire pit for cooler evenings.
highlights: Private rooftop pool with panoramic views
Smart TV and AC in every bedroom
Electric fire pit in the living area
Close to Dingli Cliffs and Golden Bay
sleeps: Two ensuite bedrooms, one of them the master on the top floor. Sleeps four.
nearby: Mdina, St Paul's Catacombs and the Rabat restaurants are on foot. Dingli Cliffs, Golden Bay and Għajn Tuffieħa are a short drive.
good_for: Explorers of the west of Malta

name: Designer Apartment near Paceville, St Julian's
intro: A standout designer one-bedroom apartment a few steps from Paceville. Open-plan kitchen with island, rain shower, smart TV with streaming, AC in every room, a private balcony and a big sofa bed for two extra guests. Lift and self check-in.
highlights: Steps from Paceville nightlife and restaurants
Sofa bed, sleeps up to four
sleeps: One bedroom with a double bed plus a large sofa bed in the living room. Sleeps up to four.
nearby: Paceville, St George's Bay beach, Spinola Bay restaurants and the St Julian's bus routes are all a short walk.
note: Residential building with quiet hours from 11pm to 7am and a noise monitor.

name: Maltese House with Terrace and BBQ near Balluta Bay
intro: A charming three-storey Maltese maisonette between Spinola and Balluta Bay. Two king-size bedrooms, a cosy living room with an L-shaped sofa, an open-plan kitchen and a spacious private terrace with dining table, chill-out corner and BBQ.
sleeps: Two bedrooms with king-size beds. Sleeps four.
nearby: Balluta Bay, Spinola Bay, the Sliema promenade and the St Julian's cafés are all on foot.
note: The house is on three floors with stairs throughout.

name: Penthouse with Private Pool in Msida
intro: A modern three-bedroom penthouse in central Msida with an expansive terrace, a BBQ and your own private swimming pool. Lift access, ensuite bathrooms, a dedicated workspace and the marina and restaurants a short stroll away.
sleeps: Three spacious bedrooms. Sleeps six.
nearby: Msida marina, the University of Malta and Mater Dei Hospital are close. Valletta, Sliema and St Julian's are all a short bus ride.

name: Duplex Penthouse with Sea-View Terrace in St Paul's Bay
intro: A two-floor penthouse a few steps from the waterfront in St Paul's Bay. Open-plan living with an L-shaped sofa and smart TV, a large private terrace with BBQ and electric shades, sea views from the terrace and kitchen balcony, and two bedrooms with their own balconies downstairs.
highlights: Private terrace with BBQ and electric shades
AC in all bedrooms and the living room
sleeps: Master bedroom with a double bed and a second bedroom with a double-size bunk setup. Sleeps four.
nearby: The St Paul's Bay and Bugibba promenades, boat trips to Comino and the Blue Lagoon, and buses to Valletta and Mdina.

name: Modern Two-Bedroom Apartment with Balconies in Msida
intro: A newly furnished apartment in the heart of Msida, finished to a high standard with marble-effect porcelain floors, AC in every room and three balconies. Open-plan living and kitchen, two generously sized bedrooms and self check-in.
sleeps: Two bedrooms with twin single beds that can be arranged as doubles. Sleeps four.
nearby: Msida marina, the University of Malta, and bus links to Valletta, Sliema and St Julian's in minutes.

name: Boutique Designer Apartment with Soaking Tub in Pietà
intro: Not a standard apartment. A sunken lounge with coffered ceiling and warm cove lighting, a walnut kitchen with Moroccan tiles, a boutique-hotel bedroom and a bathroom that is really a private spa: a round cedar soaking tub against black marble, plants and candlelight. Five minutes from Valletta.
highlights: Walnut kitchen with Moroccan tile splashback
Antique desk and leather chair for working
sleeps: Master bedroom with a walnut feature wall and dressing nook. Sleeps up to four.
nearby: Valletta is five minutes by car, Sliema and St Julian's ten. Mater Dei Hospital and Msida marina are around the corner.

name: Duplex Penthouse with Terrace and BBQ in St Julian's
intro: A bright, recently renovated duplex penthouse in the heart of St Julian's, with a private lift that opens straight into the apartment. Two double bedrooms on the lower floor and, upstairs, an open living space leading to a large sun terrace with BBQ and dining for the whole group. Spinola Bay, Paceville and the seafront are a short walk away.
highlights: Large private terrace with BBQ and dining table
Private lift opening into the apartment
Two double bedrooms, one ensuite, one with balcony
Air conditioning in every room and fast WiFi
Fully equipped kitchen and washing machine
sleeps: Two double bedrooms. Sleeps four.
nearby: Spinola Bay, Balluta Bay, Paceville and the Sliema promenade are all within walking distance.
note: There are stairs from the street to the lift, and an internal staircase between the two floors, so it is not suitable for guests with reduced mobility.

name: Ensuite Room in a Sliema Townhouse (Room 3)
intro: A first-floor private room with its own bathroom in a renovated traditional townhouse in central Sliema. Large bed, walk-in wardrobe, air conditioning and a lockable door. Guests share a fully equipped kitchen, a back patio with a big BBQ and a rooftop terrace.
highlights: Shared kitchen with Nespresso machine and air fryer
Back patio with BBQ and rooftop terrace
sleeps: One private bedroom with a large bed. Sleeps two.
nearby: Central Sliema: shops, the seafront promenade and Exiles beach all within a few minutes' walk.
note: A private room in a shared house with two other guest rooms. The kitchen, patio and rooftop are shared.
